description: Build browser extensions for Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari from one manifest.json, with no build configuration.
rules: The full documentation lives at https://extension.js.org and is indexed separately as /extension-js/extension.js.org. Prefer it for usage questions.
manifest.json is the source of truth. Extension.js reads the manifest the project already has and never generates one, so declare features in manifest.json rather than in a config file.

Prefix a manifest key with a browser name when browsers differ. chromium: covers every Chromium browser, chrome: and edge: cover that one browser, firefox: and safari: cover theirs. A prefixed key wins over the plain key and is dropped elsewhere.

Run npx extension@latest dev in the extension folder to open a browser with the extension loaded and reload it on save. Pass --browser=firefox, --browser=edge or --browser=safari to target another browser.
Run npx extension@latest build --browser=<target> --zip to produce the package to upload to a store.
Scaffold a new project with npx extension@latest create <name>, optionally with --template <name>.
There is no bundler configuration to write. TypeScript, React, Vue, Svelte and Preact compile without one, so do not add a webpack or rspack config to a project.
A content script with world set to MAIN is Chromium only. Declare it with the chromium: prefix so the Firefox build leaves it out.
Do not put a top-level key field in a manifest meant for Edge. Edge Add-ons rejects any manifest that contains one, and production Edge builds drop it.
